purpose: Owner Q4a: R4 trains the Hybrid fresh on observation v2 (heading error from take-off at 41-42), half the episodes plain and half randomized; scored against the tuned PD alone, with the gate's hand-over at 60 (default), 90, 120 and 150 deg.

validation_seeds.cells: A-F x both modes x plain/randomized

outcome: R4 best with the hand-over at 120 deg: plain 94.93% vs PD 94.84% (loses A Arcade -1.1, A Realistic -0.3, E Arcade -0.9), randomized 92.14% vs 88.74% (no cell lost, F +19). Stage F landing heading median 2-4 deg plain (R3: 11-19). At the 60 deg default it loses B badly (Realistic -25): it never trained on B and tips some of those cars over.
